title: Michael Saylor Says Bitcoin May Go ‘Boring’ as Institutional Money Kills Volatility
summary: MicroStrategy's Michael Saylor warned that Bitcoin's growing institutional adoption could transform the volatile asset into a "boring" store of value as corporate treasuries reached a record 1.011 million BTC worth over $118 billion. The post Michael Saylor Says Bitcoin May Go ‘Boring’ as Institutional Money Kills Volatility appeared first on Cryptonews .
